description: Two independent staged CB1 runs of the same action tape (seed 391728405), policy-phase fixed ticks only (post-horizon rows excluded). Compared per tick.
note: Rigidbody state (velocity, rb position, contact count, grounded, crouch) is repeatable. The interpolated Transform position sampled before FixedUpdate depends on render-frame timing and is not repeatable (up to 0.39 m); the Isaac port uses the rigidbody position.
